title: Mutable Legacy Date vs Immutable Temporal Types

before.label: Legacy Date (Mutable & UTC-Trap)
before.code:
const d = new Date('2026-03-08'); // UTC midnight -> Mar 7 in US!
d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1); // Mutates in place, 0-indexed months
before.previewNote: Silently mutates operands and conflates calendar dates with UTC instants.

after.label: Temporal.PlainDate & ZonedDateTime
after.previewNote: Separates wall-clock dates from timezones and preserves DST invariants.
